Bulletin No: 16 MWA/26/07/12/01
COLOR: Amber
Advisory for Strong Winds and Rough Seas
Issued by the Natural Hazards Early Warning Centre
Issued at 11.00 a.m. 12 July 2026
Valid for the period until 11.00 a.m. 13 July 2026.
For the sea areas extending from Matara to Pottuvil via
Hambantota and from Chilaw to Kankasanthurai via Puttalam.
PLEASE BE PREPARED!
The sea areas off the coasts extending
from Matara to Pottuvil via
Hambantota and from Chilaw to
Kankasanthurai via Puttalam will be
rough at times with strong gusty
winds up to (50-60) kmph.
Naval and fishing communities are
requested to be vigilant and be
attentive to future forecasts issued by
the Department of Meteorology in
this regard.
